झ: झ The ninth consonant of the Deva Nagara alphabet; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding in power to Jh.

झ mfn. (झः झा झं) 	 1. Asleep, sleeping. 	 2. Lost, destroyed. 	 m. (झः) 1. A name of VRIHASPATI, preceptor of the gods. 	 2. A name of the chief of the Daityas or demons. 	 3. Sound or a sort of sound like the splashing of water, or the classing of cymbals, jangling, clanging, &c. 	 4. High wind. 	 5. A stray, a thing lost or mislaid. 	 6. Playing a tune, beating time. 	 f. (झा) The descent of a cascade, a water fall.  E. झट to collect, affix ड.
झङ्कार: झङ्कार m. (-रः) A low inarticulate sound, as the buzzing of bees, &c. E. झ, and कार a making. कृ-घञ् ।
झञ्झन: झञ्झन n. (-नं) An indistinct noise, like the jangling of metallic orna-ments, a ringing, a rattling, &c.
झञ्झा: झञ्झा f. (-ञ्झा) 	 1. Wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale. 	 2. A sharp clanging sound, jangling. 	 3. Raining in large drops. 	 4. A stray, any thing lost. झमिति कृत्वा झटति झट-ड ।
झञ्झानिल: झञ्झानिल m. (-लः) Wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west monsoon.  E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and अनिल wind; also झञ्झा-मरुत्, &c.
झञ्झावात: झञ्झावात m. (-तः) Wind with rain, a storm, a squall.  E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and वात wind.
झट: झट r. 1st. cl. (झटति) To clot, to be entangled, (as hair:) see जट. E. भ्वा-पर-अक-सेट् ।
झटा: झटा f. (-टा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)  E. झट् to entangled, affix अत्र्.
झटि: झटि m. (-टिः) A small tree, a shrub, a bush.  E. जट् to be entangled, इन् Unadi aff.
झटिति: झटिति ind. Quickly, speedily, instantly.  E. झटि entangling, confusing, affix इन् क्तिन्; also जटिति.
झनत्कार: झनत्कार m. (-रः) The clanging of metallic ornaments, &c.  E. झनत् imi-tative sound, &c. कार making.
झम: झम (उ) झमु r. 1st cl. (झमति) To eat: see जमु, &c.  E. भ्वा-प-सक-सेट् ।
झम्प: झम्प mf. (-म्पः-म्पा) Jumping, springing, plunging.  E. झं imitative sound, and पत् to fall, affix ड.
झम्पाक: झम्पाक m. (-कः) A monkey or ape.  E. झम्प, and अक to go. झम्पेन आकायति आ + कै-क । वानरे ।
झम्पारु: झम्पारु m. (-रुः) A monkey, an ape.  E. झम्प plunging, and अश् to go, उण् aff.
झम्पाशिन्: झम्पाशिन् m. (-शी) A kingfisher.  E. झम्प plunging, and अश् to eat, affix णिनि.
झम्पिन्: झम्पिन् m. (-म्पी) A monkey, an ape.  E. झम्प springing, इनि aff.
झर: झर m. (-रः) 	 f. (-रा or -रिः-री) A cascade, a water-fall. 	 f. (-री) A river. E. झॄ to waste or decay, affix अप्, fem. affix टाप्, इन् or ङीष्; also निर्झर.
झर्च: झर्च r. 6th cl. (झर्च्चति) 	 1. To say. 	 2. To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्छ झर्ज, &c.  E. तुदा० प० सक० सेट् ।
झर्छ: झर्छ r. 6th cl. (झर्छति) 	 1. To say. 	 2. To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्च.  E. तुदा-प-सक-सेट् ।
झर्ज: झर्ज r. 6th cl. (झर्जति) 	 1. To say, to speak. 	 2. To censure, to blame. E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
झर्झ: झर्झ r. 1st and 10th cls. (झर्झति झर्झयति-ते) 	 1. To speak or say. 	 2. To censure or reprove. r. 1st cl. (झर्झति) To kill or hurt.
झर्झर: झर्झर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of drum. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The Kaliyuga, the pre-sent Yug or age of the world. 	 2. The name of a river. 	 3. A cane-staff. 	 4. A cymbal f. (-रा) A whore. 	 n. (-रं) A sound as of splashing or dropping.  E. झर्झ an imitative sound like that of water splash-ing, &c. and र what makes, from रा with ड affix, or झर्झ to cen-sure, and करच् Unadi aff.
झर्झरक: झर्झरक m. (-कः) The Kaliyug.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
झर्झरीक: झर्झरीक m. (-कः) 	 1. The body. 	 2. A country. 	 3. A picture.  E. झर्झ to injure or destroy, ईकन् affix, and र inserted.
झलञ्झला: झलञ्झला f. (-ला) The flapping of an elephant's ears, or loose breasts, &c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise made.
झलरी: झलरी f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of drum. 	 2. A curl.  E. झल imitative sound, र from रा to get or make, affixes ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.
झला: झला f. (-ला) 	 1. A daughter, a girl. 	 2. Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or glistering light. 	 3. A cricket; also झाला.
झल्ल: झल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe follow-ing such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung from the outcaste Kshetriya  E. जल् to surround or embrace, ल added, and ज changed to झ.
झल्लक: झल्लक n. (-कं) Cymbals.  E. झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.
झल्लकण्ठ: झल्लकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon.  E. झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.
झल्लरी: झल्लरी f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of drum. 	 2. A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी. 	 3. A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair. 	 4. Moisture. 	 5. Purity.
झल्लिका: झल्लिका f. (-का) 	 1. Light, splendour, lustre. 	 2. A rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes. 	 3. Dirt brought off the body by rub-bing it with perfumes.  E. झर्झ ण्वुल् पृषो० ।
झल्ली: झल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of drum: see झलरी.
झल्लोल: झल्लोल m. (-लः) A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
झष: झष r. 1st. cl. (झषति-ते) 	 1. To kill or hurt. 	 2. To take. 	 3. To put on, to wear.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । ग्रहणे पिधाने च भ्वा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।

झष m. (-षः) 	 1. A fish. 	 2. The sign “Pisces” of the Zodiac. 	 3. Heat, warmth. 	 4. A forest, a thicket. 	 f. (-षा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) 	 n. (-षं) Waste land.  E. झष् to injure, affix कर्मणि घ ।
झषकेतन: झषकेतन m. (-नः) A name of KANDARPA.  E. झष a fish, and केतन a ban-ner, who bears a fish on his banner.
झषाङ्क: झषाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of Kandarpa झष, E. a fish and अङ्क a mark or symbol.
झषाशन: झषाशन m. (-नः) The gangetic porpoise.  E. झष fish, and अशन food.
झषोदरी: झषोदरी f. (-री) An epithet of Satyabati the mother of the poet VYASA. E. झष a fish, and उदर the belly: born from the belly of a fish.
झांकृत: झांकृत n. (-तं) 	 1. A tinkling ornament worn on the toes or the feet. 	 2. A gurgling or rattling noise.  E. झां a jungling or jingling, and कृत made (by which.)
झाट: झाट m. (-टः) 	 1. An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers. 2. A wood, a thicket. 	 3. Cleaning sores or wounds. 	 f. (-टा-टी) 	 1. Jasmine. 	 2. A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झाट n. (-टं) A wood, a thicket.  E. झट् to be entangled, affix णिच् अच् । निकुञ्जे कान्तारे व्रणादीनां मार्ज्जने भूम्यामलक्यायां यूथिकायां च ।
झाटाल: झाटाल m. (-लः) A kind of flower: see घण्टापाटलि.  E. झट् to entangle, affix णिच् अलच ।
झामक: झामक n. (-कं) A burnt or vitrified brick.  E. झम् to eat, affix कर्मणि ण्वुल् being fed upon by fire. (झामा) ।
झामर: झामर m. (-रः) A small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spindles, needles, &c.  E. झाम eating, wearing away, from झम् to eat, affix भावे घञ्, and र what gets, from रा with ड aff.
झार्झर: झार्झर mf. (-रः-री) A tabor player, a drummer.  E. झर्झर a cymbal, affix अण्; also with ठक् affix झार्झरिक.
झालरी: झालरी f. (-री) A kind of drum or tabor.  E. झलरी the same, अण् pleo-nastic aff.
झालि: झालि f. (-लिः) A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mus-tard, and asafœtida.
झावु: झावु m. (-वुः) A tree, (Tamarix Indica;) also with कन् added झावुक m. (-कः) and with a long final vowel झावू m. (-वूः) The words are con-sidered as irregular or foreign. झा-इति वाति गच्छति वा डु (झाउ) स्वार्थे कन् ।
झिङ्गाक: झिङ्गाक n. (-कं) A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.) (भिङ्गा).
झिङ्गिनी: झिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A torch, a firebrand, The fire falling from heaven. 	 2. A sort of cucumber (Luffa acutangula.) or the tree. लिगि-णिनि पृषो० । जिङ्गिनीवृक्षे, उल्कायाम् च ।
झिङ्गी: झिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. The wick of a lamp. 	 3. light, lustre. 	 4. The Jhingine tree. see झिल्ली.  E. लिगि अच् गौरा० ङीष् ।
झिञ्जिम: झिञ्जिम m. (-मः) A forest on fire.
झिण्टी: झिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A shrub, (Barleria cristata.)  E. झि imitative sound, रट् to utter, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
झिरी: झिरी f. (-री) A cricket.  E. झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to make, affixes ड and ङीष्: also झिल्ली; भिरिका, and (कन् being add ed); also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c. झिरिति अव्यक्तशब्दोऽस्ति अस्या इन् ।
झिरुका: झिरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see the last.
झिल्लि: झिल्लि f. (ल्लिः) 	 1. Cymbals. 	 2. A cricket. 	 3. Membrane: see झिल्ली. चिल्लति चिल-अच् पृ-गौरा-ङोष् आतपरुचौ, कीटभेदे वर्त्त्याञ्च ।
झिल्लिका: झिल्लिका f. (-का) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. The light of sunshine, strong light, splendour. 	 3. Dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with perfumes. 4. A cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents, &c. 	 5. A cricket's cry. 	 6. Membrane, thin skin, parchment.  E. झिल्ल for चिल्ल imitative sound, expressing the cricket's chirp, and ङीष् being added झिल्ली, and कन् again added झिल्लिका; also with the penulti-mate long झिल्लीका.
झिल्ली: झिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. Sunshine, light, lustre. 	 3. The wick of a lamp. 	 4. A cloth or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c. 	 5. A musical instrument, cymbals. 	 6. Membrane. E. See the preceding.
झिल्लीकण्ठ: झिल्लीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon.  E. झिल्ली a cricket, and कण्ठ the throat, chirping as it were in the throat.
झीरिका: झीरिका f. (-का A cricket: see झिरी.
झीरुका: झीरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
झु: झु r. 1st cl. (झवते) To go or move.
झुण्ट: झुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 	 1. A tree. 	 1. A shrub, a bush.  E. झट् to be entangled, affix अच्, नुम् augment, and the vowel changed to उ. ल्युण्ठ अच्-पृ० ।
झूणि: झूणि f. (-णिः) 	 1. A kind of betel nut. 	 2. Heavenly annunciation of misfortunes.
झूमेरि: झूमेरि f. (-रिः) One of the Raginis, or modes of music personified.
झूष: झूष r. 1st cl. (झूषति) To hurt or kill.
झॄ: झॄ r. 9th cl. (झॄणाति) (ष) झॄष् r. 1st cl. (झीर्य्यति) To grow old, क्य्रा० दिवा-प० अक० सेट् । to become infirm with age, &c. to decay.
झोड: झोड m. (-डः) The betel nut tree,
झ्यु: झ्यु r. 1st cl. (झ्यवते) To go or move. गतौ भ्वा० आ० सक० अनिट् ।
